授業形態
（内容）
Each Lecturer introduces and discusses key concepts and narratives from various perspectives on East Asia and Japan. The classes will be conducted online (further details will follow).
使用する教材等
Powerpoint and handouts
全体の教育目標
- Understanding and mastering various perspectives on East Asia and Japan
- Getting familiar with key concepts from political, religious and urban studies
- Applying critical approaches to historical and contemporary issues in East Asia and Japan
- Fostering a political awareness on social issues
個別の教育目標
- Getting familiar with case studies of specific regions and cities
